metadata.source: Synthetic demo data - NOT real municipal records

planned_works.title: SV Road Resurfacing - Andheri West
planned_works.description: Complete bituminous resurfacing of SV Road from Andheri station junction to Juhu Circle. Includes pothole repair, drainage cover replacement, and road marking.
planned_works.traffic_impact: Full road closure in phases, diversions via Link Road

planned_works.title: LBS Marg Flyover Repair - Kurla
planned_works.description: Structural repair and waterproofing of LBS Marg flyover near Kurla terminus. Expansion joint replacement and bearing pad renewal.
planned_works.traffic_impact: Partial lane closure, alternate flyover route available

planned_works.title: FC Road Widening - Dadar
planned_works.description: Road widening along FC Road near Shivaji Park with new pedestrian pathway and cycle track installation.
planned_works.traffic_impact: Major diversions expected, work in phases

planned_works.title: Water Main Replacement - SV Road Segment
planned_works.description: Replacement of 900mm CI water main along SV Road from DN Nagar to Irla Bridge. Includes valve chamber construction and 45 new service connections.

location.landmark: DN Nagar to Irla Bridge stretch

planned_works.traffic_impact: Trench cutting required, partial road closure

planned_works.title: Bandra Pipeline Extension
planned_works.description: Extension of 600mm water pipeline from Bandra Reclamation to Carter Road with new distribution network for 2,000 connections.

planned_works.title: OFC Laying - SV Road to Link Road
planned_works.description: Optical fiber cable laying from SV Road junction through internal roads to Link Road. HDPE duct installation with 96-fiber cable for FTTH rollout.

location.landmark: SV Road Junction to Link Road via Veera Desai Road

planned_works.title: 5G Small Cell Installation - BKC
planned_works.description: Installation of 25 5G small cells along BKC connector roads with fiber backhaul. Pole mounting and cabinet installation.
planned_works.traffic_impact: Intermittent lane closures for crane operations

planned_works.title: Storm Drain Upgrade - Andheri Subway
planned_works.description: Upgrade of storm water drain capacity near Andheri subway. Box drain construction with 2x increased cross-section to prevent waterlogging during monsoon.
planned_works.traffic_impact: Deep excavation required, full lane closure near subway

seeded_conflicts.location_summary: SV Road, Andheri West, Ward K/W
seeded_conflicts.description: 4-way conflict: Road resurfacing, water main replacement, OFC laying, and storm drain upgrade all targeting the same 200m stretch of SV Road within overlapping timeframes.
